title: Austin Eyes Land for Infrastructure Growth
summary:
*   Discussions focused on acquiring property for the U.S. 290/SH 71 highway project.
*   The city considered purchasing land on Todd Lane for a new solid waste vehicle maintenance facility.
*   Another land acquisition on Todd Lane was reviewed to expand parking and storage for the Water and Wastewater Utility.
